content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted insurance agent Karan Joshi to check the status of the prorated refund for his cancelled health policy (HP-2024-5678), noting he has not yet received the credit on his card. Karan Joshi confirmed that the refund was processed on 24/09/2026 and should reflect in his account within 5-7 business days, advising him to reach out if it does not appear by 07/10/2026.

action_items: Customer to wait 5-7 business days for the refund to reflect
Customer to follow up if the refund is not received by 07/10/2026
